web.title: LPG Price in Pakistan for October 2026: Cylinder Up to Rs 3,296.23
web.description:
OGRA set LPG at Rs 279.34 a kg for October 2026, so an 11.8 kg cylinder can cost up to Rs 3,296.23.

**The official LPG price in Pakistan is Rs 279.34 a kilogram for October 2026, up Rs 20.69. The 11.8 kg home cylinder now has a maximum price of Rs 3,296.23, which is Rs 244.14 more than in September. The new price applies from 1 October.**

OGRA set the maximum consumer price of LPG at Rs 279,341.49 a tonne for October 2026. That works out to Rs 279.34 a kilogram and Rs 3,296.23 for an 11.8 kg domestic cylinder. The price is effective from 1 October 2026.

| Item | September 2026 | October 2026 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per kilogram | Rs 258.65 | Rs 279.34 | Up Rs 20.69 |
| 11.8 kg cylinder | Rs 3,052.09 | Rs 3,296.23 | Up Rs 244.14 |
| Per tonne | Rs 258,651.52 | Rs 279,341.49 | Up Rs 20,689.97 |

Over three months, the official cylinder price has risen Rs 447.32, from Rs 2,848.91 in July to Rs 3,296.23 in October. That is a 15.7 per cent rise. More than half of it came this month.

| Month | Per kg | 11.8 kg cylinder | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| July 2026 | Rs 241.43 | Rs 2,848.91 | Base month |
| August 2026 | Rs 254.32 | Rs 3,000.92 | Up Rs 152.01 |
| September 2026 | Rs 258.65 | Rs 3,052.09 | Up Rs 51.17 |
| October 2026 | Rs 279.34 | Rs 3,296.23 | Up Rs 244.14 |
